name: Baked Alaska
body:
Station and Complexity patissier 5, rotisseur 6

Flavor Profiles texture, sweet, temperature, sweet, temperature
Additional Ingredients salty, sour, spicy, or texture

EFFECT

Duration 1 round/level; Serving Size 6
Saving Throw none (harmless); Spell Resistance no (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

Baked Alaska is a cake topped with ice cream, covered in meringue and toasted. It requires knowledge of several different preparation techniques and the reflexes to avoid melting the ice cream or scorching the top.

When consumed, it grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Dexterity or Intelligence for the duration.

Additional sour and texture ingredients each grant a +1 enhancement bonus to Dexterity, or increase the bonus by +1.

Additional salty and spicy components each grant a +1 enhancement bonus to Intelligence, or increase the bonus by +1.
